title: hot cues and memory cues
system_instruction_addendum: HOT CUES ADDENDUM: Hot cues are jump points. If the user has rekordbox cues, use them; otherwise frame cue 2 as the breakdown entry. Do not narrate scratching.

tutor_speak.text: hot cues are jump points you can hit at any time. cue 1 is usually the first kick; cue 2 is usually the breakdown entry.
press hot cue 2 on deck b to enter on the breakdown: the deck jumps straight to it.

hints.text: the hot cue pads are the row of square buttons under the jog wheel.
the second pad in the row is hot cue 2.
press hot cue 2 on deck b now.
